t: The Hager Sollysta WMDP84N 20A 1-gang control switch with a white finish features a raised slim profile with a durable screwed faceplate. An integrated LED indicator provides clear operational status. Electricians will appreciate the ease of installation with backed-out captive screws and clear terminal markings. It requires a 25mm back box.
b: Upward Facing Backed-Out Captive Terminal Screws
